title: The Sacred Pendulum
summary: An interactive Three.js travertine rotunda where a dual-cable brass pendulum traces slowly precessing Lissajous patterns into glowing sand.
description: An interactive Three.js harmonograph and 30-second film. Inside a vaulted travertine rotunda lit by an oculus, a dual-cable brass plumb bob carves a slowly precessing rose into illuminated sand with live harmonograph tuning and synthesized acoustic resonance.
